coverage_context.trap_assumption: Exact raw EBREAK is an all-live terminal exit only in the pinned startup, IRQ-disabled SoC and profile/checked simulators that terminate on trap; no generic exception handler.
coverage_context.return_assumption: Only canonical raw jalr x0,x1,0 is an ordinary compiled-C ABI return; not arbitrary binary control flow.
coverage_context.resolved_direct_calls: Only exact adjacent raw AUIPC/JALR pairs with a shared nonzero base resolve: x1/x1 link calls or x0/base non-linking direct tail transfers. Targets must be aligned and in-program; every second word is protected against all static entries; transfers remain all-live barriers.
coverage_context.readonly_counters: Only exact CSRRS rd,{cycle,cycleh,instret,instreth},x0 encodings; opaque all-live isolated barriers, never fusion members.
coverage_context.unsupported_entries: Every other unknown effect or unsupported indirect entry makes extraction fail closed; both static branch edges, resolved call targets and continuations remain protected.
coverage_context.extraction: Scoped guarded ORIGINAL_EXTRACT; existing relocation guard, calibration filter and rank stratification unchanged.
coverage_context.verification: Reconstruct saved original assembly, linked static program, complete baseline profile and source-PC map for every callback; never trust candidate-supplied proof.
